conditions.settings: Lighthouse pinned-version default mobile CPU, network, screen emulation, and storage reset
conditions.beforeDelivery: Public Cloudflare Pages deployment at audit time
conditions.afterDelivery: Production static export served locally over HTTP/1.1 with gzip text compression and no-store response headers
conditions.previewSeo: Preview SEO scores are reported but excluded from threshold gates because Cloudflare preview deployments may intentionally return X-Robots-Tag: noindex.
conditions.limitation: Same runner, Chrome, Lighthouse, and emulation; CDN/HTTPS/network/cache conditions differ. This is not a controlled production speed experiment.
conditions.fieldData: Not collected. LCP and CLS below are lab measurements; navigation audits do not establish field INP or 75th-percentile Core Web Vitals.
conditions.accessibility: Automated audit only; passing scores do not establish full WCAG 2.2 AA conformance.
conditions.baseline: Before means the live site at audit time; preserve this artifact before a production release changes that site.
